# Badge

Small non-interactive numerical value or status descriptor for UI elements.
See [Badge guidelines<i class="ds-icon-launch" />](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/badge/design/)

To display a status with a text use the <LinkTo kind="Components/Chip" story="docs">Chip</LinkTo> component.

<Canvas of={BadgeStories.Basic} />

```css
.bg-warmgrey-20 {
  background-color: #111111;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

### Placement

Choose placement with these modifier classes : `ds-badge--topright`, `ds-badge--bottomright`, `ds-badge--bottomleft` or `ds-badge--topleft`.

If needed, adjust position with `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right` CSS properties on the `ds-badge-count` or `ds-badge-status` child element.

<Canvas of={BadgeStories.Placement} />
